findings.issue: Make Ves perform the instrument adjustment explicitly after either entry branch.

changed_fields.before: On the roof, a little brass vane turns freely for the first time in years. Ves reads the cloud line without consulting a slip. She admits the forecasts were meant to help people prepare, not prove that she could be right. Your companions settle behind the newly sheltered chimney.
changed_fields.after: Ves moves the little brass vane onto a free bracket above the wall. From the roof she reads the cloud line without consulting a slip. findings.issue: Listening or locating the rubbing point did not itself repair the bridge; make the mender finish the work.

changed_fields.before: The repaired bridge has stopped humming, but the little bell still whistles through its crack. Tal decides it may warn people without pretending to hold the whole span together. Across the gap, someone has placed a pot of hot barley water beside three cups of very different sizes.
changed_fields.after: Tal finishes the necessary knots before inviting you across. The little bell still whistles through its crack, but no longer rubs the rope. He decides a warning need not pretend to hold the whole span together. Across the gap, someone has placed a pot of hot barley water beside three cups of very different sizes.

findings.issue: Both pantry paths now lead honestly to a meal and balanced house; Oru completes the work, rather than crediting an unchosen player action.

changed_fields.before: The house sits level enough for its front door to close without a rope. Oru serves the simple meal on the step, where a passing neighbour can choose whether to stop. changed_fields.after: Oru finishes balancing the cupboards and puts a simple meal on the step. The front door can now close without a rope, and a passing neighbour can choose whether to stop. findings.issue: Clarify that Kelm opens the windows after either inspection or door-bracing route.

changed_fields.before: The upper windows open toward a slow stream of warm bubbles. Kelm expected a dramatic bloom, but the first change is simply that the branches stop leaning against the glass. change_summary.encoding_cleanup: Corrected nine accidentally substituted apostrophes in these edits before validation.

mechanical_honesty.battles: Named creatures in reviewed prose are local sightings or noncombat interactions. Battle choices promise a generic wild opponent or practice group, never a specific species, victory, guaranteed capture or additional catch ticket.
mechanical_honesty.rare_token: Read current journey_combat/journey_service behavior: rare is one normally scaled opponent and uses the shared run encounter/capture policy. Three misleading rare-opponent descriptions were changed to one wild encounter with normal habitat rarity rules.
mechanical_honesty.materials: The run has one material-or-nest reward slot. Material selection can replace its saved bundle with a same-rarity offered alternative; where no alternative exists the runtime supplies a capped bundle bonus. Content now avoids fixed material IDs, additional bundles and pantry-food inventory promises.
mechanical_honesty.bounded_effects: All effects are schema-whitelisted and bounded. Descriptions do not invent permanent stats, extra currency streams, resurrection or consumable rewards. Runtime-effective descriptions communicate already-used research/recovery/bonus limits.
mechanical_honesty.choices: Every node has two or three distinct consequences and an unconditional noncombat, no-damage option. Practical help, investigation, preparation, social response and bounded risk occur in specific local contexts; choices are not one global four-button menu.
mechanical_honesty.persistent_world: Gated follow-ups have authored flag producers. Branch flags and root completion are separate; no effect resets encounter completion. Some later invitations deliberately depend on the earlier branch, while unfinished locations remain resumable.

distinctness.method: Compared normalized full body and outcome strings across all ten catalogs; manually read every reviewed root to compare stakes, ecological details, voices and branch causality.
distinctness.editorial_note: Accessible public routes, quiet care and imperfect repairs recur as the game tone. Concrete situations differ across ridge weather, submerged households, warm coral infrastructure, celestial civic spaces and living gardens. No noun-substitution body template was found in the reviewed set.

verification.strict_body_range: All 320 authored node bodies are 35-80 whitespace-separated words.
verification.applied_edit_check: All 38 final after-values in the editorial change log match the current catalogs; every changed field is body, label, description or outcome.
verification.limits: This is a content and graph review, not a claim that every possible world-history combination or combat balance has been simulated. Runtime persistence, reward settlement and battle pacing are covered by their separate test/audit work.

coverage_addendum.issue: Stormglass Peaks and Abyssal Trenches originally had no repeatable battle choice; the remaining later biomes offered only a single opponent. After one-time content was finished, those catalogs could remove battle/catch opportunities or lose pack variation.
coverage_addendum.resolution: The content author added seven contextual third choices to existing repeatable roots. Independent review verified every prior root, node, choice, effect, flag and continuation edge is preserved; the new terminal choices add only battle intentions.
